# Anne Shirley

## Overview

- **Age:** 17 years old by the end of Volume 2  <sub>[v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c3 P16](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P28](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** Unmarried; engaged to Gilbert Blythe  <sub>[v2 c30 P42](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0042)</sub>
- **Rank:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher at Avonlea School  <sub>[v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** B.A. (Bachelor of Arts)  <sub>[v1 c34 P27](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0027), [v1 c36 P12](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0012)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Anne of Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c8 P56](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0056)</sub>; Cordelia  <sub>[v1 c3 P15](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0015)</sub>; Carrots  <sub>[v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slender girl with gray-green eyes, a pale complexion with a few freckles on her nose, and a well-shaped nose. Her thick hair, which she hated in her childhood when it was bright red, has darkened over time into a glossy auburn. She enjoys wearing tasteful, fashionable dresses with puffed sleeves.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c11 P9](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0009), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c3 P43](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0043), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008)_

## Personality

Anne is an imaginative, romantic, and talkative girl who views the world with enthusiasm and deep appreciation for beauty. Though quick-tempered and impulsive in her youth, she matures into a thoughtful, dutiful, and earnest young woman. She is fiercely loyal to her friends and possesses a strong desire to bring joy to others. Despite her vivid imagination, she holds herself to high moral standards and seeks to live up to her ideals.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c2 P24](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0024), [v1 c5 P5](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0005), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c31 P23](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0023), [v2 c1 P2](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0002), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 c7 P15](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0015), [v2 c10 P38](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0038)_

## History

Anne Shirley was born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, to schoolteachers Walter and Bertha Shirley, who both died of fever shortly after her birth. Left an orphan, she spent her early childhood in poverty and hard labor caring for children for Mrs. Thomas and Mrs. Hammond, followed by four months in an asylum. At age eleven, she was sent by mistake to Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert of Green Gables in Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, who had wanted a boy to help on the farm. Despite initial intentions to send her back, her vivid imagination and affectionate nature won over the siblings, and they decided to keep her. Anne settled into Avonlea, forming a deep 'bosom' friendship with Diana Barry and entering into a fierce academic rivalry with schoolmate Gilbert Blythe after he angered her by calling her 'Carrots.' She progressed rapidly in her studies under her teacher Miss Stacy, eventually attending Queen's Academy in Charlottetown, where she earned a First Class teacher's license and won the prestigious Avery Scholarship. Following the sudden death of Matthew Cuthbert and the failing eyesight of Marilla, Anne chose to give up her college scholarship to stay at Green Gables and care for Marilla. She took a position as the schoolteacher in Avonlea, where she successfully managed her pupils and founded the Avonlea Village Improvement Society. After two years of teaching, she reconciled her long-standing grudge against Gilbert Blythe, accepting his offer of friendship after he gallantly surrendered his post at the Avonlea school to her.

## Background by volume

- Orphaned at three months old when her parents died of fever  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised in neglected conditions by Mrs. Thomas and later Mrs. Hammond to care for their children  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Spent four months in the Hopeton orphan asylum before being brought to Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Adopted by Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert of Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005)</sub>
- Attended Queen's Academy and tied for first place in the entrance exams, winning the Avery Scholarship  <sub>[v1 c32 P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040), [v1 c36 P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007)</sub>

> I’d like to add some beauty to life. I don’t exactly want to make people know more . . . though I know that is the noblest ambition . . . but I’d love to make them have a pleasanter time because of me . . . to have some little joy or happy thought that would never have existed if I hadn’t been born.  <sub>[v2 c7 P15](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0015)</sub>
